fields.description: Build order. Hold points check every required stage with a lower sequence.
fields.label: Sequence

fields.description: Earlier required stages must be Accepted before this stage can be submitted.
fields.label: Hold Point

fields.description: An Accepted inspection at this stage releases the QC Unit. Only one stage should have this set.
fields.label: Final Release Stage

fields.description: Loads one test row per tagged hose on the unit (crimp diameter, test pressure, hold time, leak check)
fields.label: Per-Hose Test

fields.description: Loads one row per pump/motor group on a power unit (nameplate check, rotation, relief and compensator as-set)
fields.label: Per-PMG Test

fields.description: Loads the unit's proof test items (and allows adding more) with P1/P2 pressure, media, duration and leak check
fields.label: Proof Test Record

fields.description: Loads one row per coating layer (product, brand, code, mils, recoat and cure time)
fields.label: Coating Application Record
All Parts Present
fields.description: Inspections at this stage cannot be completed while the unit has missing parts not yet marked Found (e.g. testing).
The unit's build package must be released (and still match the unit's Drawing / Rev) before this stage can be completed (QM-400 8.5.1).
fields.label: Requires Build Package Release

fields.description: Welders must be listed and authorized before this stage can be completed. When the unit's Welding Standard requires a code, traceable material (heat/lot and MTR) is required too.
fields.label: Weld Traceability Record

fields.description: Qualification a welder needs for work under a welding code (AWS / ASME).
fields.label: Code Welder Skill

fields.description: In-house welding authorization for PSIF workmanship work (no code). A code-qualified welder also counts.
fields.label: Workmanship Welder Skill

fields.description: The inspector must hold an active Skill Authorization for this skill to complete the stage (QM-400 7.2, 8.5.1 e).
fields.label: Inspector Skill Required
